detail.longDescription: We recently watched a team use a shared canvas for a brainstorming session. At first, they struggled with the 'loudest voice' dominating the room. We suggested a silent brainstorming phase where everyone added their ideas to the canvas simultaneously without speaking. The result was a richer, more honest set of insights than any spoken meeting could have produced. # omnicanvasnotes # digitalworkspace # canvaslayout # brainstorming # collaboration # productivity
